top_comments.text:
For anyone wondering why the red sunglasses work, it's because blue and white lights keep you the most awake, while red doesn't have nearly as much effect. The Blue light represents morning light to the brain, making it day something like 'OMG, it's morning! Wake up' 
IDK why blue light specifically, maybe the blue sky, but that's just a theory. White light doesn't directly truck the brain, but it's usually related to bright lights, like the sun. 
Sung good examples are: 
-You feel more awake when outside with sunlight than inside with artificial light
-Buses for longer drives and some cats have blue lights for the drivers to keep awake
-If you like Astronomy and star gazing, you know the tip to wrap your flashlight in red cellophane


If you read all of this TYSM ❤️.

top_reply.text: Its not the color is the amount of light. Instead of turning night mode on that makes the colors warmer you should be turning down the brightness and distancing the device from your eyes. top_comments.author: @AshleySuarez-b2z
top_comments.text:
Sunglasses work because, in our brains if we see light (worst blue lights) they basically turn off the melatonin in our body. Stimulating us to not sleep (melatonin is what makes us tired) but, with warm toned to no light our brains turn on the melatonin.

If you don’t understand, if we see light worst blue lights our brain thinks it’s day and gives energy and stimulation to our bodies. But, with no and warm toned light the brain thinks it’s night. So it gives us melatonin and we fall asleep.
